verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a library, not an editor-centric tool, so scenes are inherently built via code/npm (NullEngine for headless rendering, server-side support, NPM/ES6 modules) — this enables CLI/CI usage in principle. However, there is no documented official CLI, build/export pipeline, or CI/headless-testing example specific to game export workflows; the evidence only shows generic headless-engine primitives, not an end-to-end automated build/export toolchain. missing for 10: an official CLI or build tool for scene/asset export, documented CI pipeline examples, evidence of automated packaging/export without any editor interaction, independent confirmation of headless CI usage.
